offering_description.value: Operates online marketplaces where travelers book tours and activities and diners reserve restaurant tables. Its websites and apps help travelers compare lodging and plan trips using user reviews, and give travel businesses and restaurants tools to reach customers and manage bookings.

primary_products.value: restaurant reservation and table management software

primary_services.value: tour and activity booking; travel reviews and trip planning; lodging price comparison and referrals; restaurant reservations; travel advertising

customer_segment.value: B2C: Travelers booking activities or researching trips and diners reserving tables; B2B: Tour operators, hotels, online travel agencies, restaurants and travel advertisers

end_markets.value: tours and attractions; lodging; online travel booking; restaurants; travel advertising

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: Tour and activity bookings and diners seated through the restaurant marketplace; advertising: Paid lodging referrals, sponsored placements and display ads; subscription: Restaurant management software and enhanced business listings
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; advertising; subscription

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Combines user reviews, lodging offers and supplier inventory to connect travelers and diners with operators, hotels and restaurants; service provider: Provides booking management and advertising services to travel businesses and restaurants

geography_served.value: global: Travel services across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions, restaurant reservations mainly in Europe

specialization.value: related lines: Tour and activity booking, travel reviews and lodging comparison, restaurant reservations and restaurant software

distribution_channels.value: online: Company websites and mobile apps for travelers and diners; partners / resellers: Travel agencies and third-party travel sites that distribute tours and activities; direct sales: Sales teams serving hotels, restaurants and advertisers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Online booking, advertising and customer data subject to consumer protection and privacy rules, including the EU GDPR

notes: The current relative scale of the experiences marketplace and the travel media business is uncertain.
